label: Hot Reload / Testing
title: Debugging, testing, and hot reload
lead: Are you tired of restarting the game to test your mod?
bodyHtml:
Fast mod-testing loop

Most CUCoreLib iteration gets faster when you separate startup-only work from content registration. Keep console commands, Harmony patches, and other one-time setup in Awake(), but move reloadable content into a dedicated host class or explicit replay methods and apply hot reloading.

Usage

The preferred entrypoint contract is a single marker call inside your plugin Awake():

private void Awake()
{
    CacheMyAssets(); // startup-only work
    ContentReloadManager.EnableHotReload(GUID);
    RegisterReloadable();
    FantasyGameplayHooks.PatchAll(harmony, Logger);
}

Everything before EnableHotReload(GUID) is startup-only and never replayed. The marker call must use the plugin's literal GUID string constant so the scanner can verify it against [BepInPlugin].

In the default flexible guarded mode, CUCoreLib scans calls that appear after the marker, follows local helper-to-helper chains, discovers replayable registration leaves, and suppresses some startup-only APIs such as Harmony setup during replay.

Commands


      reloadcontent com.example.mymod
      autohotreload com.example.mymod true
      autohotreload com.example.mymod false
  • reloadcontent <modGuid> re-reads the mod's configured hot reload source DLL, clears the mod's previously registered reloadable content, and replays only recognized content methods from that rebuilt assembly.
  • autohotreload <modGuid> true enables persistent watch mode for the same configured hot reload source DLL of a mod that previously called EnableHotReload(GUID).
  • autohotreload <modGuid> false disables the saved watch mode for that mod.

By default, the hot reload source is still the deployed plugin DLL that BepInEx loaded. If Windows refuses to overwrite that file while the game is open, set [Hot Reload] -> <modGuid>.overridePath in CUCoreLib.cfg to an alternate rebuilt DLL path such as your project's bin\Debug output.

Watch mode automatically polls the selected source DLL, then runs the same reload flow automatically instead of you having to run reloadcontent.

Automatic discovery rules

  • Supported reload surfaces are asset loading, locale/text, liquids, items, basic building entities, and recipes.
  • Harmony patch setup, console command registration, save hooks, mod options, multiplayer hooks, tiles, structures, and live scene mutation currently do not work and are blocked.

Limitations

CUCoreLib's built-in DLL reload path is still singleplayer only and only restores reloadable content owned by that mod after clearing the old registered entries.

Testing your mod in multiplayer

By default, the game has a limitation of one instance, making testing in multiplayer difficult. However, there is a workaround:

  • In Casualties Unknown Demo\CasualtiesUnknown_Data\boot.config, remove the entire forceSingleInstance: 1 line.
  • Open the multiplayer mod on two instances and swap from Steam to IP hosting.
  • The name of the client and the host must be different.
  • Connect on both, and you can test multiplayer interactions.

Launch overrides and optimizations

For testing elements that are not covered by hot reload, CUCoreLib has a configuration for loading directly into a test world or tutorial.

In BepInEx -> Config -> CUCoreLib.cfg, there are options to instantly load the debug world or tutorial on launch.
